product.name: BlueCargo Container Management Platform
product.description: A software platform that monitors, forecasts, and manages container movements and demurrage and detention charges at port terminals.

identifier.value: Per Diem Invoice Audit and Dispute Service

product.name: Per Diem Invoice Audit and Dispute Service
product.description: A service that audits per diem invoices for compliance and accuracy, helping customers dispute and reduce detention and demurrage charges.

product.name: Terminal and Vessel Schedule Monitoring
product.description: A feature that provides access to terminal gate and vessel schedules for multiple steamship lines and port terminals to aid container movement planning.

product.name: Container Shipment Watchlist and Tracking
product.description: A tool to track container status and maintain a watchlist for monitoring shipments and managing container flow through ports.

identifier.value: Reporting Dashboard and Custom Contract Management

product.name: Reporting Dashboard and Custom Contract Management
product.description: A dashboard providing reporting on container operations and a system to manage custom contracts related to container handling and per diem charges.
